title: JobTerminalPayload
description: Payload for the durable jobs.terminal stream topic, recording the final outcome of a background job. Sourced from the transactional outbox; never coalesced or dropped.

error.description: Error message when status is failed or cancelled due to an error.

result.description: Optional summary or artifact reference of the completed job result.

completed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the job reached terminal state.
